title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: The failure originates in the Sentry .NET NuGet package's source generator and its Roslyn/Visual Studio compatibility, so it is SDK-specific rather than a Sentry server issue.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure is an event-details/UI 500 caused by Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp handling, so it is primarily an Issues product malfunction. No SDK-specific ownership or confirmed transfer evidence is present.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: This is a confirmed defect in Sentry core's global export/import relocation logic: ProjectKey.write_relocation_import collapses multiple keys per project and can regenerate public keys. It is not an SDK-specific or self-hosted packaging issue.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: The issue is explicitly about a self-hosted deployment failing while configuring a GitHub repository integration. A closely matching confirmed transfer for a self-hosted repository-integration setup failure was routed to getsentry/self-hosted.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: The failure is in Sentry's taskworker/Kafka topic resolution: configured topic prefixes are not applied before taskbroker production, causing authorization failures and blocking envelope processing. This is core Sentry ingestion infrastructure rather than an SDK defect or merely a Helm deployment issue.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
